title: 第3章 功德祥云第4章 真是太浪费了
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
其他人也热烈地附和着，希望童元安能来一趟。
童元安没有立刻回答，而是先询问道：“从这里去你们部落，得多长时间？”
他清楚记得，在这世界只能停留三天时间，现在已经过去半天了。
铜木回答说：“要是快点儿赶路的话，差不多要一天。”
童元安点了点头，答应下来：“那就多叨扰一天吧。”
看到童元安同意了，铜木他们都特别高兴。
“启程，返回部落！”
随着他的命令下达，众人纷纷拿起自己的战利品起身。
“队长，我的腿断了，没办法继续背这些肉了。”
一个粗犷面孔的中年男子满脸歉意地说道。
“丢掉吧。”
铜木看了眼那些鲜红的蛇肉，无奈地说。
这次扔掉的东西不只是这一块儿肉，一大半狩猎所得都带不回去。
也是没有办法的事儿，周围的食物早就被消耗殆尽，只能到远一些的地方打猎。
人族体力不如那些巨型野兽，所以每次能够带回的东西都非常有限。
对于他们而言，这次带回的东西已经算是不少了，毕竟所有受伤的人都被治愈了。
如果不是这样，还得留下人照顾伤病号以及巡逻人员，最终可以带回的食物就会少得可怜。
食物意味着活下去的机会，但现在却不得不放弃很多，让人十分无奈。
“哎！
走吧！”

铜木重重地叹了一口气。
刚转身时突然发现仙师朝他走了过来。
“好不容易才打到这么多猎物，就这么丢了未免太可惜了吧。”
童元安意味深长地说，显然他已经看出现在的人族生活多么艰难。
铜木无可奈何地表示：“我们也不是不想带走更多啊，可你看我们现在连这都已经竭尽全力了，再多真是背不动了。”
童元安微微一笑，胸有成竹地说：“我可以帮你们想办法将这些东西都运回去。”
听到这话，四周的人群立即炸开了锅。
“是真的吗？”
“如果真能把所有东西都带走，那就等于今天我们打了四天的猎！”
“这样一来孩子们这几天就不会挨饿了，老人也可以得到足够的照料！”
“太棒啦！”
“感谢老天爷，仙师简直就是我们的守护神啊！”
content_en:
Others also echoed enthusiastically, hoping that Tong Yuanan could come.
Tong Yuanan did not answer immediately, but asked first: "How long does it take to get to your tribe from here?"
He clearly remembered that he could only stay in this world for three days, and now half a day had passed.
Tongmu replied: "If we hurry up, it will take almost a day."
Tong Yuanan nodded and agreed: "Then let's bother you for one more day."
Tongmu and the others were very happy to see Tong Yuanan agree.
"Let's set off and return to the tribe!"
As his order was given, everyone picked up their trophies and stood up.
"Captain, my leg is broken, I can't carry this meat anymore."
A middle-aged man with a rough face said apologetically.
"Throw it away."
Tongmu glanced at the bright red snake meat and said helplessly.
This piece of meat was not the only thing that was thrown away this time. Most of the hunting proceeds could not be taken back.
There is nothing that can be done. The surrounding food has been exhausted long ago, so we can only hunt farther away.
The human race's physical strength is not as good as those giant beasts, so what they can bring back every time is very limited.
For them, what they brought back this time was already quite a lot. After all, all the injured people had been healed.
If this were not the case, people would have to be left to take care of the sick and injured as well as patrol personnel, and the food that could eventually be brought back would be very little.
Food means a chance to survive, but now we have to give up a lot, which makes people very helpless.
"Hey!
Let's go! "
Tongmu sighed heavily.
When he turned around, he suddenly found the immortal master walking towards him.
"It took a lot of effort to catch so many prey. It would be a pity to lose them like this."
Tong Yuanan said meaningfully, obviously he has seen how difficult human life is now.
Tongmu said helplessly: "It's not that we don't want to take away more, but you see we have tried our best to even take away more. We really can't carry any more."
Tong Yuanan smiled slightly and said confidently: "I can help you find a way to transport all these things back."
Hearing this, the crowd around him immediately exploded.
"Is it true?"
"If we could really take everything away, it would be like we hunted for four days today!"
"This way, the children will not go hungry these days, and the elderly will also receive adequate care!"
"Great!"
"Thank God, the immortal master is simply our patron saint!"
